name: cc-orchestrador-subagents
description: Multi-agent development orchestrator for Claude Code. Coordinates OpenSpec, Claude planning, Codex review/back-end, and Gemini front-end subagents in parallel, with API/UI contracts and a final Markdown implementation report.

plugins.name: cc-orchestrador-subagents
plugins.description: Orchestrator skill + /orchestrator slash command that drive an OpenSpec → Plan → Codex review → parallel Codex/Gemini execution → review → implementation report workflow. Runs a preflight check for gemini-cli, codex-cli, openspec-cli and required plugins before starting; cancels operation if anything is missing.
